title: BC Vienna celebrate BSL title
description: Gmunden - Vienna 60-86 Vienna clinched BSL title. They cruised past Gmunden on the road in Game 4 to conquer the trophy. The game without a history. BC Vienna led from the first minutes and controlled entire game increasing their lead in each quarter. They dominated on the defensive end, holding Gmunden Swans to just 6 points in fourth quarter. Worth to mention a great performance of international guard Bogic Vujosevic (192-1992) who helped to win the game recording 25 points, 9 rebounds and 5 assists. American center Michael Hughes (203-1998, college: Duquesne) contributed with 16 points and 5 rebounds (on 7-of-9 shooting from the field) for the winners. Five BC Vienna players scored in double figures.
